comparison.objective: Remove a drone prop nut, replace the propeller, and retighten the nut; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a freely rotating propeller while turning one nut, remove and insert parts, then tighten; candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening its concentric jam nut.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the nut to come off, the old propeller to be binned, the new one seated, and the nut tightened; candidate requires a 90° setting retained through three cycles.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared primitive of resisting rotation during nut turning, but propeller replacement does not test preserving an adjustable setting against jam-nut reaction or verifying retained articulated motion.
